name: VSTECS
recent: VSTECS 于 10 月 28 日完成以 4875 万令吉向 Skyform Pte Ltd 出售 ISATEC 40% 股权，ISATEC 不再为联营公司。执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 在 10 月至 11 月间多次增持公司股份。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收与净利均同比增长。
notable: 完成以 4875 万令吉向 Skyform Pte Ltd 出售 ISATEC 40% 股权，ISATEC 不再为联营公司。
执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 于 10 月至 11 月间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 执行董事 Foo Lek Choong 在闭市期及非闭市期均有股份交易，并曾表示在闭市期内有交易意向。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 10.78 亿令吉，环比增长 3.0%，同比增长 31.7%；净利为 3031 万令吉，环比增长 32.4%，同比增长 50.3%；净利率为 2.8%，高于上一期的 2.2%。

recent_en: VSTECS completed the disposal of its 40% stake in ISATEC to Skyform Pte Ltd for RM48.75 million on 28 October, with ISATEC ceasing to be an associate company. Executive Director Foo Lek Choong acquired shares multiple times between October and November. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue and net profit grow year-on-year.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of a 40% stake in ISATEC to Skyform Pte Ltd for RM48.75 million; ISATEC ceased to be an associate company.
Executive Director Foo Lek Choong acquired shares in the open market multiple times between October and November.
risks_en: Executive Director Foo Lek Choong traded shares during both closed and outside closed periods, and had given notice of intention to deal during a closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,078.2 million, up 3.0% qoq and 31.7% yoy; net profit was RM30.3 million, up 32.4% qoq and 50.3% yoy; net margin was 2.8% versus 2.2% previously.
